description: This file defines the TerminationReasonModel class within the OrangeHRM project, used to model termination reasons in the HRM system. It uses traits for serialization and implements a normalizable interface, primarily serving as a data transformer for entity objects.

classes.name: TerminationReasonModel
classes.description: A model class that wraps around the TerminationReason entity to provide serialization and normalization functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a TerminationReason entity and configures filtering and attribute naming for serialization.
